Fact.Description: The eligibility question the flow asks first. Replace this with whatever your tool actually tests — it is here to give the knockout alert something to fire on.
Income for the year, in dollars.

Whether income is at or under the ceiling. Kept as its own fact rather than folded into /qualifies: the Outcome tracker can then show which half of the test failed, which is the whole reason to decompose a determination.
The determination. Incomplete until both inputs are answered, which is what the Outcome tracker's part-drawn ring is showing before then.
